data.name: Rachit
data.long_meaning: The name Rachit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rachas' which means 'to leap'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is believed to have taken a leap to preserve the universe. The name Rachit is thus a reminder of Lord Vishnu's divine intervention and protection.
